Likely cause: ECS backend service experiencing exit code 143 (SIGTERM) terminations causing 70 high-severity runtime failures in the last 7 days.
Confidence: medium
Supporting evidence:
• Highest-ranked finding: process or container failures in /ecs/posis-ar-backend-service — 70 occurrences (0.417/hour), severity high.
• Also present: process or container failures in /aws/lambda/sellout-api-processing (21 occurrences, high); application-level errors in /aws/lambda/sellout-notify-file-lambda-job (600 occurrences, medium).
• Scope: 16 distinct findings across 6 log groups of 69 scanned in the last 7 days.
• 4 log groups produced more matching events than the per-slice budget, so their occurrence counts are lower bounds.
executiveSummary:
• Elevated — no critical findings, but 2 high-severity findings across 6 log groups in the last 7 days.
• Biggest issue: process or container failures in /ecs/posis-ar-backend-service — 70 occurrences at 0.417/hour (high).
